strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The target SEG2 is chosen on the analysis's size and interest figures (17.5M adults, 41% intent versus SEG1 at 1.3M and 72%), and the rationale compares all four segments against the volume goals. Channels follow the accessibility figures (supermarkets 68%, gyms 6%), and the positioning answers the Barebells and private-label competition. Pricing is handled explicitly: no price war with private labels, a premium to private labels, and a shelf-price audit before fixing the price.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Every message ("Côté salé", the sporty-routine framing, gym bag and post-session moments) speaks to active adults and carries the positioning proof points (15 g per 40 g, six ingredients, Nutri-Score A on two flavours). The channel-specific messages use only the five strategy channels (supermarkets, gyms and sport shops, organic shops, online shop, Instagram), and the vegan angle appears only in claims about certification, not as a separate target.
